title: Release a camera from a cam-clamped quick-release mount
instruction: Remove the camera and its attached plate from the bench mount and set the assembly upright on the green pad. Keep the camera attached to the plate, do not drop it, and leave the assembly released.
context: Camera and robotics technicians remove mounted sensors for servicing and reconfiguration. A passive cam and rear retaining edge must be cleared before the camera assembly can be transferred to a supported resting place.
setup: Fixed calibrated bimanual YAM station with a nominal wooden 1100x1300x60 mm tabletop centred (0.36,0,0.7175) m, tabletop z=0.7475 m, x forward and y left from the midpoint between arm bases. Secured nominal aluminium fixture root (0.28,0,0.7675) m with 110x110x8 mm foot, 26x26x8 mm post, 70x52x9 mm adapter, 54x6x6 mm aluminium rear rail, 54x10x3 mm aluminium rear lip, two 4x38x4 mm aluminium guides and two 6 mm diameter screws with 2 mm visible height. Passive 18 g cam: 24x14x7 mm orange-finished aluminium lever, 22x8x5 mm aluminium bridge, 28x8x4 mm steel toe and 8 mm diameter by 8 mm steel pivot; pivot offset (25,-30,17) mm from fixture root, initially zero rotation, positive travel 0.95 rad. Camera and aluminium 50x38x5 mm plate plus 12 mm diameter by 7 mm aluminium spacer form one 83 g payload, spawned with plate underside (0.28,0,0.7775) m and settled to z=0.7765 m before the initial image. Camera uses a licensed D405 appearance, nominal aluminium housing and a 23x42x42 mm collision box in its mounted orientation. Fixed green nominal polyurethane pad 130x110x4 mm centred (0.20,0.14,0.7495) m, top z=0.7515 m. No cable. All task-object initial orientations aligned with the world; both arms start at [0,1,1,-0.6,0,0] rad with grippers open. The fixed overhead observation rig includes a 110x110x16 mm steel support foot, 24 mm diameter mast (928.321 mm capsule spine), 18 mm diameter support arm (53.852 mm capsule spine) and 50x42x22 mm ABS camera housing. setup-layout.json gives every local/world pose and background part; build_scene.py gives custom colliders. Materials and aggregate masses are nominal reconstruction parameters, not calibrated manufacturer properties.
scoring: Highest applicable endpoint tier, overridden by any permanent invalidation; otherwise 0.0. Scored mount surfaces are the enclosing boxes of the foot, post, adapter, rear rail/lip, side guides and cam lever/bridge/toe/pivot; fixed screw heads do not define clearance. 0.25: cam >=0.8 rad, payload-to-scored-mount clearance <10 mm, native contact present. 0.5: clearance >=10 mm and native contact present, if the pad tier does not apply. 0.75: plate centre <=20 mm horizontally from pad centre, full payload collision envelope over the pad, plate underside within 5 mm of pad top, tilt <=10 degrees, native contact present. 1.0: the 0.75 conditions hold, every robot collision envelope is >=30 mm clear, and every pose over a full 1 s window stays within 2 mm and 2 degrees of the window's first pose. Permanently score zero for fixture translation >5 mm or rotation >5 degrees, cam anchor error >2 mm, cam angle outside [-0.01,0.96] rad, non-finite/non-unit state, any payload collision corner outside x=[-0.19,0.91], y=[-0.65,0.65], z=[0.7425,1.2475] m, or downward travel >10 mm during an uninterrupted absence of contact. Native contact presence uses >0.02 N at 240 Hz; no real force sensor is required: use visible support/release, a ruler, protractor and video. Cam/fixture angles use their declared zero poses; payload tilt uses world vertical; stability uses the window's first pose. Endpoint pose conditions and the 1 s stability window are sampled at 20 Hz. All parts must remain intact and attached as declared. README.md defines conservative bounding-envelope approximations and real-world interpretation.
reset_notes: Restore the single declared layout, initialize the passive cam at zero, reset both arms and settle for 0.5 simulated seconds. Jitter is disabled. No consumables.
fidelity: Nominal rigid cam-and-lip mechanism with simplified collision boxes and a licensed D405 visual. Camera, plate and spacer form one rigid body. No deformation, breakage, wear, cable or camera operation is modeled. Friction and cam damping are authored, not calibrated; no hardware trial is claimed. Contact/motion audits approximate no-drop scoring; bounding envelopes measure clearance. Dream-1 gateway retries and target clipping are documented in README.md.
